_comment: First resist aura (item 11 Phase 2 Step 4): grants allies in range AND the caster (targetsSelf) a fire-damage multiplier of 0.6/0.5/0.4 at L1/2/3. Verification pair for the AngryMammothAura fire tag. All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Obtainable in dev via the SKILL FireWard cheat; no unlock source yet — real placement comes with the item 12 content pass. ⚑ R3 (plan-resource-costs-feedback §5.2): this cost is now an ENTRY price, not a sustain rate. R2 made a resist aura charge only for a genuinely new application, and the applier authors the buff lifetime as tickInterval + 1, so the ward never expires on someone standing inside it — the caster pays once when the aura goes on and once more each time a new ally walks in. Priced x3, borrowing the dot's whole-burn heuristic: a resist buff has no natural burn length to price against, so this is an activation charge, and the real counterweight is that holding it costs the one active-aura slot.
name: FireWard
